Bubble Bobble Revolution.name: Bubble Bobble Revolution
Bubble Bobble Revolution.summary: Originally released as an arcade game by Taito in 1986, Bubble Bobble starred two dinosaurs - Bub and Bob who co-operate to make their way through a hundred levels to rescue their girlfriends. This addictive two player game went on to be released on most console formats. Now the game is reborn on the Nintendo DS with all new graphics, split screen action and the classic gameplay. 100 new exciting levels to explore. All new power bubbles and bubble attacks. Microphone activated challenges and Bubble mini-games. Includes a perfect re-creation of the original Bubble Bobble arcade machine game.

Doctor Who - Evacuation Earth.name: Doctor Who: Evacuation Earth
Doctor Who - Evacuation Earth.summary:
This is your chance to be the Doctor and guide him and Amy Pond on a thrilling new adventure.
Arriving on Earth only hours before a Solar Storm is due to wipe out all life on the planet, the Doctor and his companion discover the last group of humans preparing to evacuate. No sooner have they arrived then the TARDIS disappears and they embark on a mission to recover it, encountering Silurians and Daleks along the way.

Staring the voices of Matt Smith and Karen Gillan, this brand new official Doctor Who storyline includes over 100 puzzles, plus over 60 exciting locations to explore.

Imagine - Cheerleader.name: Imagine: Cheerleader
Imagine - Cheerleader.summary: Show your school spirit by becoming a cheerleader! Use the stylus to perform different cheers, kicks, lifts, and a variety of routines.

Kabushiki Baibai Trainer - Kabutore!.name: Kabushiki Baibai Trainer Kabutore!
Kabushiki Baibai Trainer - Kabutore!.summary:
If you've been hesitant about stocks because they seem difficult or scary, then "Kabutore!" is perfect for you. You can learn the basics of stock trading while having fun playing a game.

Includes a tutorial that's easy even for beginners. Learn stock trading in a fun way with a board-game style Story Mode.

Naked Brothers Band, The - The Video Gam.name: The Naked Brothers Band: The Video Game
Naked Brothers Band, The - The Video Gam.summary: The Naked Brothers Band: The Videogame is an interactive music experience based on the highly successful Nickelodeon series. Band Manager Cooper has secured a nationwide tour for the Naked Brothers Band. The journey to success, however, is not going to be easy. Players will experience the real superstar life of the Naked Brothers Band on tour while playing instruments and singing along to 25 of their favorite Naked Brothers Band songs.

Nicktoons - Attack of the Toybots.name: Nicktoons: Attack of the Toybots
Nicktoons - Attack of the Toybots.summary: The DS version of Attack of the Toybots is a sidescroller beat-em-up with light shooter elements.

Water Horse, The - Legend of the Deep.name: The Water Horse: Legend of the Deep
Water Horse, The - Legend of the Deep.summary: Can you keep a secret this big? When young Angus MacMarrow finds a mysterious, glittering egg on the shores of Loch Ness little does he realize the excitement to come, especially when it hatches into a legendary sea monster! Join Angus and his incredible friend Crusoe the Water Horse on the adventure of a lifetime as they attempt to outwit the soldiers set on destroying the famous Loch Ness monster and help Crusoe escape to the open sea.
